notes.role: the fixture every implementation is instantiated from

injections.first_failure: legal_set_only_confirmed_negatives: legal_pool(a0-m) offers a0-p with kind 'R2' (ordinary negatives are ['R0', 'R1'] only)
injections.name: legal_set_offers_a_mate

injections.first_failure: legal_set_only_confirmed_negatives: legal_pool(a0-m) offers t0 with kind 'TINY_CONTACT' (ordinary negatives are ['R0', 'R1'] only)
injections.name: legal_set_offers_unknown

injections.first_failure: relation_value_domain: relation(a0-m, a1-m) = 'R2' but the measured row says 'R0'
injections.name: relation_is_asymmetric

injections.first_failure: assert_legal_negative_refuses_illegal: assert_legal_negative(a0-m, a0-p) accepted a historical R2 mate
injections.name: guard_accepts_a_mate

assertions.clause: the pool exposes every protocol method and a non-empty candidate universe
assertions.name: interface_present

assertions.clause: relation(a,b) is symmetric, never an adjacency for a==b, equals the measured row's kind, and never invents an adjacency for an unmeasured pair
assertions.name: relation_value_domain

assertions.clause: relation(a,b) == relation(b,a) for every pair of the universe
assertions.name: relation_symmetry

assertions.clause: mates(q) is exactly the confirmed R2 adjacency of q (q excluded)
assertions.name: mates_match_measured_r2

assertions.clause: neighbours(q) == mates(q) -- the clause whose divergence made rank never start
assertions.name: neighbours_are_mates

assertions.clause: legal_pool()/legal_negatives() contain confirmed R0/R1 candidates only
assertions.name: legal_set_only_confirmed_negatives

assertions.clause: no legal candidate and no candidate_ids entry is the query itself
assertions.name: legal_set_excludes_self

assertions.clause: a legal negative is never a mate (or a neighbour) of its query
assertions.name: legal_set_excludes_mates

assertions.clause: the two spellings of the legal set agree
assertions.name: legal_pool_equals_legal_negatives

assertions.clause: history_exclusions(q) contains every mate of q
assertions.name: history_exclusions_superset_of_mates

assertions.clause: nothing history_exclusions(q) forbids is offered by legal_pool(q)
assertions.name: history_exclusions_disjoint_from_legal

assertions.clause: the guard accepts every candidate the pool calls legal
assertions.name: assert_legal_negative_accepts_the_legal_set

assertions.clause: the guard refuses q itself, its mates and every R2/TINY/UNKNOWN candidate
assertions.name: assert_legal_negative_refuses_illegal
